about:
Sportex Apparel, based in Tempe, Arizona, traces its roots to 1988 when Sportex Safety & Ad-Vantage Marketing began designing, manufacturing, and decorating high-visibility workwear, general PPE, and safety incentive products. The company operates as Sportex Apparel of Arizona, Inc., and emphasizes domestic production with a "USA made" commitment.

The shop provides a full range of decoration and manufacturing services: screen printing with Plastisol and water-based inks, embroidery backed by over 20 years of experience, a full-service cut-and-sew department, laser engraving on hard surfaces, and virtually every printing method including pad, sublimation, offset, digital, and large format. An in-house art team develops designs and proofs, and the company handles product development for custom sportswear replica jerseys, safety apparel, and promotional product lines, including inventory management and custom webstore fulfillment. The facility accepts runs of any size.

Customers span industrial safety programs needing hi-vis garments and PPE, athletic teams ordering replica jerseys and performance apparel, collegiate licensing through the Raise the Roof brand, promotional products distributors leveraging 20-plus years of ASI expertise, and resort retailers carrying the Pre-Print Apparel lines such as Brieland Graphics and Copper Canyon Artworks.

Sportex positions itself on domestic manufacturing, a 2–3-week turnaround from discovery to delivery, no-obligation proposals with free art proofs, and a relationship-driven approach that encourages customization and innovation. The company researches products for clients and provides options based on pricing and quality.
